slots.video_prompt:

One adult hand performs one dominant action only: rotate only the right shoe about thirty degrees until its opening and heel lining face the camera; the left shoe remains stationary. Preserve exactly two shoes with complete laces, tongues, soles and heel geometry, five fingers, realistic weight and contact shadows.
